updateTitle: Yellow Spotter and Smarter Race Tools
fullTitle: 4.11.0 - Yellow Spotter and Smarter Race Tools
changelog: Added the new Yellow Spotter overlay, showing whether a stopped car ahead is on the left, right or directly ahead.
Improved the Rejoin overlay with WAIT, CARE and CLEAR alerts, smoother distance-based colour transitions and clearer traffic guidance.
Fuel Companion: F. Ratio now displays the fuel ratio set in the LMU pit menu.
Fuel Companion: fuel-gap calculation is now independent from the refuel safety margin.
Added a Virtual Energy option to choose decimal or whole-number values in Relative, Rivals and Multiclass Standings.
